title: Maria was amazing!
text: The private tour with Maria was amazing. She did an incredible job and was very patient with us and our two kids. Would highly recommend.
author: Hiba_Q

title: Alcazar and cathedral tour
text: Great tour with an amazing guide
author: Marti22_11

title: A walk through the history of Seville and the Alcazar
text: Our guide was very knowledgeable about the history of Seville and the Alcazar in particular. She also took us to a couple of places off the tourist track. We also appreciated her keeping us under shelter and shade as much as possible given the heat.
author: Leane A

title: Will definitely do this again
text: Our tour was fantastic. Our guide was knowledgeable and fun. We loved it.
author: OnAir54876094975

title: We had a wonderful tour...
text:
We had a wonderful tour of Seville with Christina. She did an excellent job showing us the Seville Cathedral, the Royal Palace of Seville, and the Jewish Quarter. Christina was very knowledgeable, explained the history clearly, and made everything interesting and easy to understand for our whole family. She was patient, friendly, and kept everyone engaged throughout the tour.

author: Teresa_M

title: Definitely recommend seeing these sights with a private tour
text: A private tour was a good way to see these sights. Yohanna was an amazing guide. She did a great job leading us around and telling us about the Cathedral & Alcázar and was able to answer all of our questions. We enjoyed visiting with her too.
author: Elizabeth_B

title: Wonderful tour!
text: Really enjoyed this tour. Belén was a great guide, very upbeat, friendly and knowledgeable. Having a private guide is worth the extra cost. Highly recommended!
author: Britt_B

title: Outstanding
text: Juan was an outstanding private tour guide: easy to communicate with, easy to understand his English, very knowledgeable, told and showed us many things we would not have looked at or understood in our own. We find the self guided audio tours in other cities a bit frustrating so this was particularly wonderful. He was also helpful with restaurant recommendation after our tour via text. Thank you Juan for an excellent experience.
author: Lynn V

title: Great Tour in Seville
text: Cristina was excellent. Very professional and knowledgeable about the Alcazar and the Cathedral. She welcomed our questions and overall provided an excellent your to the four of us. We highly recommend Cristina!!
author: R5674IYkatherineh

title: Seville Alkazar palace and cathedral.
text: We were enthralled by our visit, so much so that the three hours didn’t seem long enough! Our guide, Yohanna had so much knowledge and such a love of history that really showed.
author: David D
